[element-copyright-year]
=== `<copyright-year>` Copyright Year

The year of copyright.

#### Usage/Remarks
Since the <<element-copyright-statement,`<copyright-statement>`>> element is intended for display, this element’s contents may not be displayed (but will be available for searching). The <<element-copyright-year,`<copyright-year>`>> element need not be used, if having the year as part of the <<element-copyright-statement,`<copyright-statement>`>> is sufficient.

#### Related Elements

There are three copyright elements which may be contained in the <<element-permissions,`<permissions>`>> grouping element: <<element-copyright-statement,`<copyright-statement>`>>, which is a textual statement of the copyright intended for print and display (This full statement usually contains the copyright holder’s name and the year among other information.); <<element-copyright-year,`<copyright-year>`>>, a metadata element that names just the copyright year (This is intended for metadata searching and aggregation and is typically not displayed.); and <<element-copyright-holder,`<copyright-holder>`>>, also a metadata element that is typically not displayed.

Text, numbers, or special characters

#### Tagged Samples

#### Copyright statement and also copyright year

[source,xml]
....
...
<std-meta>
 ...
 <permissions>
  <copyright-statement>ASME is the registered trademark of The American Society 
   of Mechanical Engineers.</copyright-statement>
  <copyright-year>2017</copyright-year>
  <copyright-holder>THE AMERICAN SOCIETY OF MECHANICAL ENGINEERS</copyright-holder> </permissions>
</std-meta>
...
....
#### Copyright year and holder with no copyright statement

[source,xml]
....
...
<iso-meta id="profile.int">
 ...
 <secretariat>...</secretariat>
 <permissions>
  <copyright-year>2006</copyright-year>
  <copyright-holder>ISO</copyright-holder>
 </permissions>
</iso-meta>
...
....
